items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Alan Silva can put some big bands together that can do some marvelous things.

ctx.x: Alan Silva can put some big bands together that can do some marvelous things. I mean some serious things. But I’m just throwing out a few names, I don’t know. I don’t really know.
Well that was a hard question.
